title: DefiLoom
tagline: A CLI tool that uses PowerLoom's DeFi API to discover Arbitrage and LP APY opportunities.
description: Finding the best Arbitrage and Liquidity Providers (LP) opportunities out there is not easy. This simple tool tries to make these opportunities available to everyone with ease-of-use.
how_its_made: My project is built on top of PowerLoom's API. I found a few inconsistencies in PowerLoom's API especially in the data-types of the response being sent. Also, had a bit of trouble figuring out the needed mathematical formulas but PowerLoom's docs helped there.
